dedupe_keys.name: dreal pays de la loire flood hazard datasets

description: DREAL Pays de la Loire: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. Coverage: DREAL Pays de la Loire. The listing groups 62 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Repères de crues en Pays de la Loire; Programmes d'Actions de Prévention des Inondations (PAPI) en Pays de l; Territoire à Risque Inondation (TRI) de la baie de l’Aiguillon - Enjeu; Enveloppes Approchées d'Inondations Potentielles des cours d'eau en Pa. Formats seen: QGIS SHAPE, MAPINFO TAB, ZIP, CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
